text: The Whitehead tower of a pointed space X in HoTT is a sequence X = X⟨0⟩ ← X⟨1⟩ ← X⟨2⟩ ← ⋯ where:
choices: Each X⟨n⟩ is more connected than X⟨n-1⟩
X⟨n⟩ → X kills πₖ for k>n
Each X⟨n⟩ has π_k=πₖ(X) for k≥n and πₖ=0 for k<n
explanation: Whitehead tower: X⟨n⟩ is n-connected, with πₖ(X⟨n⟩)=πₖ(X) for k>n.
